Memories
At the hustle and bustle of life, I suddenly find myself reminiscing about my home. How long has it been since you last returned home? How long has it been since you gathered with your family?
Can you remember?
Food with seemingly simple and unpretentious dishes, yet filled with so much special emotional value. Do you know why? Because the dishes in my memory carry a very familiar flavor, a flavor that only my mother can cook. My mother always adds a special "spice" to her cooking - it's love. And that's also the secret that makes my mother's cooking so incredibly delicious.
But now all of those things are only left in my memories. I smile with the painting of a mother with a happy smile in my heart, and the simple dishes that my mother cooked that anyone who sees it will remember the love.
